title: Machine learning-based ability to classify psychosis and early stages of disease through parenting and attachment-related variables is associated with social cognition.
summary: The full-text study reports psychosocial factors associated with psychosis-stage classification in its study sample. Classification associations do not establish causal roles of parenting or attachment and do not validate a clinical diagnostic tool.
ai_technology: Machine-learning classifiers analyzed parenting and attachment-related variables in relation to psychosis-stage categories and social-cognition measures.
organization: Department of Education, Psychology, Communication, University of Bari Aldo Moro; University of Bari Aldo Moro medical departments
